(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A combination product comprising: (A) BH4, a functional derivative thereof, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4, or a biosynthetic precursor of BH4; and (B) an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II (AII), or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof, wherein each of components (A) and (B) is formulated in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, a functional derivative thereof, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4, or a biosynthetic precursor of BH4, an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II (AII), or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof, and a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a kit of parts comprising components: (I) a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, a functional derivative thereof, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4, or a biosynthetic precursor of BH4, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier; and (II) a pharmaceutical formulation including an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II (AII), or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier, which components (I) and (II) are each provided in a form that is suitable for administration in conjunction with the other.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: A combination product as claimed in any one of the preceding claims, wherein the component that is BH4 or a functional derivative thereof is a compound of formula I, O R HN R2 N R3 R -N N N R4 H R5 R wherein R1 and R2 either independently represent H or C1-2 alkyl, or together represent a bond between the C- and N-atoms to which they are attached; R3 represents aryl or C1-4 alkyl, which alkyl group is optionally substituted by one or more substituents selected from aryl, OR7 and oxo; R7 represents, independently at each occurrence, H or C(O)R8; R8 represents C1-4 alkyl, aryl, C1-4 alkoxy and C1-4 alkylamino; R4 and 5 either independently represent H or C1-2 alkyl, or together represent a bond between the C- and N-atoms to which they are attached; and R6 represents H or C(O)-C1-3 alkyl.

(Currently Amended) Claim 13: A combination product as claimed in any one of the preceding claims, wherein the inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II (AII) is a renin inhibitor, an ACE inhibitor or an AT1 receptor antagonist.
